domain: ECHELON 6 Habitat & Vehicles / Pipe & Sump Pump Logistics + Fluid Incursion

sump_runtime.storage: GlobalDataVault handles for PumpNodes, PipeEdges, NodeAup, PumpRoomIndices, CsrOffsets, CsrDestinations, CsrConductance, CsrFlow, CsrFlatEdgeIndex, CsrWriteCursor
sump_runtime.topology_rebuild: BuildCsrPipeGraphJob scheduled only when _topologyDirty is true

base_flooding_bfs.finding: Already CSR plus fixed queue. No NativeList or NativeQueue in dirty region BFS.

route_bfs.storage: DataVault scratch EdgeOffsets, EdgeDestinations, Visited, Queue
route_bfs.finding: Preallocated queue and visited arrays; tail overflow is fail-closed.

adjacent_fluid_pipe_runtime.finding: Flat zero-GC edge scan, but not CSR. Not touched because current assigned sump/flood logistics route already has CSR ownership and rewrite risk exceeds evidence.

lifecycle: OnEnable binds DataVault and initializes generation handles.
TryInitializeBuffers materializes all node, edge, CSR, pressure, power, telemetry, and GPU flow buffers in the Vault.
GenerateMockDrainageNetwork seeds deterministic topology when requested.
SlowTick resolves GlobalQualityWeight and schedules drainage only after the quality-scaled cadence elapses.
ScheduleDrainageSolve locks Vault buffers, builds CSR if topology dirty, runs pump power, pressure relaxation passes, edge flow, optional water evacuation, and telemetry recorder jobs.
LateFrameTick finalizes completed jobs, records wall time, unlocks Vault buffers in finally, then uploads visual flow data.

bfs_deconstruction.sump_solver: Not BFS. It is CSR Jacobi-like pressure propagation over contiguous edge slices.
bfs_deconstruction.base_flood_dirty_region: BFS head/tail loop over a fixed TraversalQueue; each node reads one contiguous CSR edge span.
bfs_deconstruction.queue_allocation_proof: Static rg over sump, routing, and habitat dirty BFS sources found no NativeList, NativeQueue, Queue<T>, Dictionary, HashSet, LINQ, or foreach in the inspected hot graph files.
bfs_deconstruction.cache_locality_proof: Offsets are node-index contiguous. For each source node, destination, conductance, flow, and flat edge index are linear in the same edge interval. Traversal is O(nodes + edges) with sequential reads/writes and no object graph chasing.

dto_layout.DrainageNodeDTO: LayoutKind.Explicit Size=32, hot fields at offsets 0,4,8,12,16 with padding to 32.

Replaced fixed two pressure passes with quality-driven ResolveDrainageDeltaPassCount(quality) range 1..4.
Changed sump blackbox dump route to Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_1421_FluidLogistics.bin.
Added editor stress harness for 10000 nodes and 30000 directed edges.
